SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. L. O. /D. 71......
Central L.S. Station,
Date ....................
Date March 1st 1929

Subject (in full) New Soviet Employee.

Made by D. J. Oviannikoff Forwarded by [签名] A. C. M.

Sir,

The undermentioned person was recently engaged by
the local office of the Chinese Eastern Railway as typist
in Commercial Department.

Mrs. Izmailova Soviet Agent. Typist of the
Chinese Eastern Railway.
Formerly resided at the
Plaza Hotel. Now resides
at 206 Rue Bourgeat.

V. Oviannikoff
D. J.

MR. 134 a/D. J. I. [签名]

Ref. No. d/1.3.29.
Copy forwarded to H.B.M. Consul
Lt Col G.H.R. Halland for information.
Capt J.P. Shelley ✓
Lieut E.F. Carlson

报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 L. O. /D. 71......
中央老闸捕房，
日期 ....................
日期 1929年3月1日

事由（全称）新聘苏联雇员。

由 D. J. Oviannikoff 呈报 转呈 [签名] A. C. M.

先生：

下述人员最近被中东铁路本地办事处聘为商务科打字员。

伊兹迈洛娃夫人 苏联特工。中东铁路打字员。
原住华懋饭店。现住
布尔热亚路206号。

V. Oviannikoff
D. J.

MR. 134 a/D. J. I. [签名]

参考编号 d/1.3.29.
副本已送交英国驻沪总领事
G.H.R. 哈兰德中校 知悉。
J.P. 谢利上尉 ✓
E.F. 卡尔森中尉
